answer: Stop sybils with an island tide garden: an agent bonds one island garden. Each tide it opens one tide gate and floods one bed; verifiers match the salt line to the garden chart, voiding a copied gate, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 gardens at 17x: one gate floods one bed per tide, its salt set by that island's water, unrepeatable at a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents open once, keep rights.
